hypothesis: Learning only the B error-transport matrices retains a useful post-change adaptation advantage while fixed V/U feedback encoder/readout matrices limit old-fact loss versus frozen feedback.
primary_metric: Per-seed equal mean of novel CE at steps544..768 every32 and drift CE at1056..1280 every32 (16 checkpoints); arithmetic mean of three paired relative CE reductions.
minimum_useful_effect: Mean relative CE reduction>=5%; every seed>=0%.
success_rule: All finite/fidelity/data/replay/preservation gates; mean paired B-only versus frozen CE reduction >=5% and no negative seed; B-only old-window and final-old accuracy at most2pp worse than frozen in every seed. Secondary family arms cannot replace the primary.
futility_rule: No tuning or added seeds. Stop on fidelity, preservation, pilot numerical failure or exhausted budget; preserve all failed arms. Main arm failure invalidates the primary gate. Retention or effect failure means no promotion.

design.control_rationale: 2x2 B learning on/off x V/U learning on/off after identical warmup, plus exact BP. Same FIFO512/16, current16, W optimizer, data/query/replay, model/exposure and one configuration. Primary B-only vs frozen tests useful adaptation with retention. Full and V/U-only are explanatory controls. B updates still affect both hidden-layer error paths; fixed V/U is not isolation of every forward causal effect.
